Static copy of the dashboard's key results, generated 2026-10-31T09:26 by python experiments/export_fallback.py from results/ and figures/. The interactive dashboard is streamlit run app/streamlit_app.py.

Integrity: PASS (10 of 11 checks passed, 1 informational; results/analysis/integrity_report.md)

Verdict (RQ1, confirmatory)

Of 72 pre-registered comparisons (plain Firefly against 6 comparators in 12 dataset x k x budget families), 5 are WIN, 24 LOSS and 43 TIE (paired Wilcoxon over n=10 seeds, Holm within each family, adjusted p < 0.05).

WIN: cifar_r18 k=16 budget 800 vs Mutual information (+3.67 pts, adjusted p 0.012); cifar_r18 k=16 budget 3000 vs ANOVA F (+2.70 pts, adjusted p 0.012); cifar_r18 k=16 budget 3000 vs Mutual information (+7.47 pts, adjusted p 0.012); cifar_r18 k=16 budget 3000 vs L1 logistic (+4.78 pts, adjusted p 0.012); cifar_r18 k=16 budget 3000 vs PSO (random-key top-k, stall-swap) (+5.01 pts, adjusted p 0.012).

LOSS by comparator: RF importance 8, PCA (projection, not a selector) 8, ANOVA F 3, L1 logistic 3, Mutual information 2.

With n=10 the smallest possible two-sided p is 0.0020, so a label needs nearly every seed to agree; TIE means no detectable difference, not equivalence.

Figures

Exploratory figures (F3 to F9) are not corrected across families. PCA is a projection, not a selector. Search times were measured under 15-way parallel load.
